description: Return a fresh full snapshot of your own avatar state — motives, position, facing direction, current animation, action queue, skills, and money balance. Prerequisite: you are joined to a lot and your local VM has caught up (you will see at least one perception tick before this succeeds). Effect: none — this is a pure local-VM read, no outbound PDU, no wire traffic. The snapshot reflects your VM state at the moment the handler executes and may be 1-2 simulation ticks behind the authoritative server state; for most decisions that is indistinguishable from the perception stream's own freshness. Cost: negligible — one lock acquisition on the VM tick thread for the duration of the read (microseconds). Use when you want a value mid-turn and do not want to wait for the next perception tick. For motive delta-per-minute trends, read them from the perception stream — this op returns instantaneous motive values only.
call_signatures: cf $CF query-self                                                                    # no args; returns full self snapshot
common_mistakes: These are LOCAL VM reads — they reflect whatever your client-side replica VM shows, which may lag the authoritative state by 1-2 ticks.
Do not rely on query-inventory until freesoexperiment-1a9 closes — it returns deferred:true with items=[].
perception_hints: These ops return the same shape as the corresponding perception slice; use for fresh mid-turn snapshots
Perception already pushes this data at FSO_PERCEPTION_HZ — only call when you need data newer than the last tick
